You can see in the photos it is not perfect though. ... on the aft side it is almost like that, but still a bit of a ramp where you can see the tip kissing the surface. But on the fore side, as we bring the camera around the side you see we do make quite a lot of contact with the surface there for a bit, and then we get gaps again.

fitted.said: Regarding the faucet tip and faucet display cover, that is the best fit that we've had of anything ever. It's amazing. I love it. It's actually like a hole in the faucet tip that just didn't get quite covered by the display cover. And other than that, I mean, I think it looks pretty damn good.
